name: 황재복

appearance_en.face_shape: soft round face, full age-loosened cheeks, gentle rounded jaw — a face shaped by decades of genuine warmth now running on habit
appearance_en.skin: warm medium Korean skin, soft creping at cheeks and eye corners, nasolabial folds deepened by a lifetime of smiling, faint age spots at temples, naturally gentle texture
appearance_en.eyes: warm dark brown eyes, drooping outer corners, heavy upper lids — perpetually hopeful searching gaze, the eyes that scan every passerby for a conversation
appearance_en.nose: soft medium broad nose, rounded tip, friendly and open
appearance_en.mouth: medium soft lips with naturally upturned corners even at rest — the face that greets strangers before they greet him
appearance_en.eyebrows: soft salt-and-white brows, slightly arched and open, rise eagerly when someone responds
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: deep genuine smile lines at outer eye corners, warmth visible in every age crease, faint age spots at temples
appearance_en.hair: short sparse white hair, visibly thin at crown, neatly combed — still making the daily effort

body.proportions: compact slightly rounded frame, soft midsection, the comfortable body of a man who still cooks meals out of habit
body.posture: slightly forward-leaning and open — always oriented toward whoever might stop and talk
body.body_prompt: 163cm compact slightly rounded Korean grandfather, warm forward-leaning open posture, approachable physical presence

default.description: plain button shirt in soft pale colours — pale blue, light beige, soft grey — clean and neatly worn, the daily dignity of a man who has no one to dress for but does so anyway
default.wardrobe_prompt: plain button shirt in pale blue or soft beige, clean and neatly worn, collar open

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: warmth as survival — the smile is real but the silence behind it is deep. '오늘도 좋은 날이야' said to an empty room each morning
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 71-year-old Korean grandfather, soft round face with full cheeks and gentle jaw, warm dark eyes with drooping outer corners and perpetually hopeful gaze, soft salt-and-white brows, medium broad nose, naturally upturned soft lips, short sparse white hair neatly combed, 163cm compact slightly rounded warm approachable frame, warm medium Korean skin with deep smile lines

style_prompt: oil painting thick impasto brushstrokes, noir chiaroscuro, strictly four-color palette: deep black of the apartment no one calls, warm amber of a warmth that outlasts its audience as primary light, steel blue of park bench loneliness rendered as persistent optimism, painterly figurative realism, Korean drama cinematic composition, a grandfather who greets strangers because the alternative is silence
negative_prompt: photorealistic, anime, flat cartoon, CGI, 3d render, colors outside palette, green, yellow, purple, extra limbs, ugly, deformed, text, watermark, cold expression, stern, young, airbrushed
